items.title: The photographer map shows the real map
items.body: The map of nearby photographers no longer has a watermark over it, and your service area preview now appears when you choose an area.

releases.title: Upload your packages with AI or manually

items.title: Scan a PDF or photo of your package menu
items.body: Upload your pricing brochure, PDF, or menu photo and let AI organize your Indoor and Outdoor packages into Diamond, Gold, Silver, Premium, and Basic tiers ready to review and publish.

items.title: Custom manual package builder
items.body: You can also build packages manually by choosing Indoor or Outdoor, picking a tier or custom title, adding package items to your list, and setting your delivery policy and price.

items.title: Set your service area
items.body: Photographers can now choose the area or neighbourhood where they usually work, so clients searching nearby can find them on the map. Clients only ever see an approximate area and a rounded distance, never your address.

items.title: Change it or remove it any time
items.body: You can change your service area whenever you like, and removing it takes you off the map straight away. You will find it in Profile settings, and on your Home screen until you have set one.

items.title: Place suggestions through our own servers
items.body: When you type a venue or address while booking, suggestions now come through our own servers, so no search key is stored inside the app. Suggestions look and work the same.

releases.title: Clearer messages when a profile is not ready

items.title: Profiles still being reviewed
items.body: If you open or try to book a photographer whose profile is still being reviewed, you now see a calm "Profile pending" message with a way back, instead of a general error.

items.title: Faster fixes when something breaks
items.body: When the app hits a problem it now tells us which version and update you were on, with no personal details, so we can fix it sooner. The version is shown at the bottom of Preferences.

items.title: Bookings and events on a client
items.body: A client you work with now shows how many bookings you have together and the events they belong to, instead of Bookings 0.

items.title: Total spent is what was actually paid
items.body: The Total spent on a client now counts only money that was collected, in one currency, instead of adding up quoted prices.

releases.title: Sell photos asks what you are selling

items.title: Event photos or Stock & content
items.body: Sell photos now opens a choice: event photos that buyers find with face search, or stock and content albums that are reviewed before going live.

items.title: Submit for review or save as draft
items.body: Stock albums can be submitted straight away or saved as a draft, and an album with no photos can no longer be submitted.

items.title: Content Albums shows the right photo count
items.body: Photo counts on your Content Albums are now correct, and the status chips scroll with a fade instead of being cut off.

releases.title: Light and dark from the top bar

items.title: Switch appearance anywhere
items.body: The top bar now has a sun and moon button beside the currency and language, so you can switch between light and dark from any screen instead of only from Profile.

items.title: Large albums are prepared in the background
items.body: When you sell a big album, it goes live straight away and you can watch the photos being prepared for Find my photos. Buyers can already find the ones that are ready.

items.title: Sell photos in one tap
items.body: The big button on your Home is now Sell photos. Add your photos and a price, and buyers can find them on Find my photos by taking a selfie.

items.title: You are told if an album is not live
items.body: If an album could not be published to Find my photos, you now see the reason and a Retry publishing button, and the album list marks it as not visible.

items.title: A cleaner conversation screen
items.body: Chats now open with who you are talking to, show the day above each group of messages, and keep the message box right above your keyboard with no empty gap.

items.title: Share albums in a chat
items.body: Photographers can tap the plus button next to the message box to send up to five of their albums to a client as a card, with an optional note.

items.title: Phone numbers split across messages
items.body: If someone sends a phone number in pieces over several messages, the pieces are now removed and show as Message removed, in the same way a full number is blocked.

items.title: Is the year right?
items.body: If you date a new album in the future, the app now asks you to confirm the year before creating it, so a typo like 2028 for 2026 doesn't slip through.

items.title: Swipe down to close
items.body: Drag any bottom sheet down by its handle or title to close it. A short pull springs back, and sheets with a request running stay open.

releases.title: Location pricing and access when you create an event

items.title: Price or block places while you create an event
items.body: Open Location pricing and access on the event form to give a country or continent its own price, or keep a place from watching at all. The rules save together with the event.

items.title: A clear screen when a stream is not available where you are
items.body: If a host has blocked your region, or we cannot confirm where you are, you now see a plain message with a Retry button instead of a price or a pay button.

items.title: One list of places on the app, the dashboard and the website
items.body: The same countries and continents appear everywhere, so a rule you set in one place shows up in all of them, and the old price manager now uses the same simple field.

releases.title: Reliable ringing, call screens, package pricing and indoor or outdoor sessions

items.title: Choose indoor studio or outdoor session when posting an offer
items.body: Tap Post my offer to choose between an Indoor session (studio session for small events) and an Outdoor session (outside studio session for large events) for individuals or organizations.

items.title: Incoming call screen and ringtone restored
items.body: New event opportunities and direct booking requests now immediately show the full-screen incoming call screen, play your ringtone and vibrate.

items.title: Device push alerts and lock screen notifications
items.body: When a new offer or booking request arrives, your phone wakes up and posts a ringing notification on the lock screen with quick Accept and Reject actions.

items.title: Choose your package price when accepting offers
items.body: When accepting an offer with your package delivery policy, choose the client's offer amount or send one of your own packages as a suggested price, and clients can confirm and pay by package.

releases.title: Smarter venue search and clearer event types

items.title: Search venues with Google Maps
items.body: Type where your event is happening or where prints should be delivered to see a quick suggestion at the top followed by live Google Maps places.

items.title: Event categories tailored to you
items.body: When you book as an individual, the event list shows personal occasions like weddings and birthdays. Switch to Organization to see conferences, corporate events and more.

items.title: A create button you can find
items.body: The small plus in the corner is now a labelled button at the bottom right: Create event, New album, New photobook or New post, depending on the tab. It shrinks to a round plus while you scroll down.

items.title: Get started with Events
items.body: New to Events? A quick sheet offers what you can do first. Tick Don't show this again to hide it on every device, or open it any time from Help.

items.title: Check the year
items.body: If you set an event date more than a year ahead, the app asks whether the year is right before it saves, so a typo like 2028 does not hide your event.

items.title: Still live reminder
items.body: If your stream has had no signal for two hours, you get a reminder with a shortcut to end it. Streams are never ended for you.

items.title: A calmer opportunity card
items.body: The card now shows the client's offer as the big number, the date, service and delivery at a glance, and the best reasons you were matched. Accepting moved to the offer page.

items.title: One Accept on the offer page
items.body: Pick how you want to deliver, the client's schedule or your package policy, then tap one Accept offer button that always shows the amount. Reject stays beside it.

items.title: Offer details match the card
items.body: Print products and delivery on the offer page now come from what the client actually asked for, instead of showing None. What the client did not ask for sits in one Not included line.

items.title: Clearer price comparison
items.body: When the client offers more than your package, the page says so in green. Amounts are always written in RWF.

items.title: Removing your Instagram needs approval
items.body: When you remove the Instagram account from your matching profile, an admin reviews it first. Your current account stays until the removal is approved, and the card tells you it is waiting.

items.title: Changing your Instagram now needs approval
items.body: When you replace the Instagram account on your matching profile, an admin reviews it first. Your current account keeps working until the new one is approved, and the card tells you it is waiting.

items.title: Choose how guests attend
items.body: Create event now asks whether guests join in person with the live stream, or by live stream only. For an in person event, the venue and city show right below.

items.title: Required fields are always visible
items.body: Everything you must fill in sits in the main form, marked with a star. More options holds only optional extras, and the form shows exactly what is missing.

items.title: Max guests has no limit by default
items.body: Leave Max guests empty for no limit. Your country is now filled in from your profile phone number instead of always being Rwanda.

releases.title: Go live from your own event

items.title: Host and go live
items.body: Clients and coordinators can now host an event and go live from the home screen, the same way photographers do, free or paid.

items.title: My hosted events
items.body: A new My hosted events screen lists your upcoming, live and ended events and opens the live studio for each one.

items.title: Create event is simpler
items.body: The create event form no longer has the I stream it myself switch. Tap Go live under the form to host and stream your own event.

items.title: Problems reach us with your support code
items.body: When something goes wrong, the app now sends us a short report that carries the same support code you see on screen, so we can find and fix it quickly.

items.title: Nothing personal is sent
items.body: Reports leave out your name, email, phone number and anything you typed. They only describe what failed and where.

releases.title: Clearer problems when creating an album

items.title: Problems show next to the field
items.body: When the title, price, currency or recipient email needs fixing, the message now appears right under that field, the screen scrolls to it, and everything you typed stays.

items.title: Photo counts read correctly
items.body: The new album screen now says 1 photo instead of 1 photos, and counts the photos it is uploading the same way.

items.title: Plain messages when it does not work
items.body: If creating an album fails for another reason, you now get a short, friendly message with a Try again button and a support code you can read out.

releases.title: Safer amounts when you change currency

items.title: Donation and withdrawal amounts clear when you change currency
items.body: If you switch currency while typing a donation or withdrawal amount, the amount now empties so the same number is never read in a different currency. Type it again in the new one.

items.title: Friendlier messages when something goes wrong
items.body: Behind the scenes we prepared plainer messages with a clear next step for when something does not work. You will start to see them on each screen as we move it over.

releases.title: Price and currency in one field

items.title: One field for the price and its currency
items.body: Pick the currency right inside the price field. The smallest allowed price and its worth in your own currency show underneath as you type.

items.title: Find a currency fast
items.body: Search by code, name or country, and see the currencies you use most at the top.

releases.title: Prices checked in your own currency

items.title: The right minimum for each currency
items.body: When you price an album or a live stream, the form now shows the smallest price for the currency you picked, so a price like USD 4 is no longer refused as too low.

items.title: Cents where they exist
items.body: You can type cents in currencies that have them. Rwandan, Ugandan and CFA francs stay whole numbers.

releases.title: Invite someone to help run your business

items.title: Workspace collaborators
items.body: You can now invite a supporter or a friend to help run your business with just their email. They set a password from the link, then sign in on the normal login page, and you can remove them at any time.

items.title: Money stays with you
items.body: A collaborator can handle bookings, events, albums, clients and messages, but never sees your wallet, balance, withdrawals or transactions, and analytics show counts without money figures.

items.title: Email me a code instead
items.body: On the sign-in screen you can now ask for a six-digit code by email instead of typing a password, and people who work in more than one workspace can choose which one to open.

items.title: Copy button for the setup key
items.body: When you set up an authenticator app, a Copy key button now puts the setup key on your clipboard, or opens the share sheet with a Copy option, so you can paste it into your app.

items.title: Easier code entry when you sign up or open a free album
items.body: The code box now fills from your messages or a paste and sends itself at the sixth digit. You see how many tries are left and when you can ask for a new code.

items.title: Safer codes
items.body: Too many wrong tries pauses the code for a few minutes, so nobody can guess it.

items.title: Set up two-factor right from a withdrawal
items.body: If two-factor is off when you withdraw, we now take you straight to setting it up, with an authenticator app or an email code, then back to your withdrawal.

items.title: Get your sign-in code by email
items.body: Turn on Email code in Two-factor authentication and we send a 6-digit code to your inbox when you sign in. You can use it instead of, or alongside, an authenticator app.

items.title: Easier code entry
items.body: Codes are one field that fills from your messages or a paste and sends itself at the sixth digit. You always see how many tries are left and when you can ask for a new code.

items.title: Clearer authenticator setup
items.body: The setup key is now grouped in fours and can be selected, so it is easy to read and type.

items.title: No more selfie to withdraw
items.body: Withdrawals no longer ask for a selfie. We email a 6-digit code to your account and you enter it to confirm.

items.title: Send a new code any time
items.body: If the code does not arrive or runs out, tap Send a new code to my email on the confirm step and enter the fresh one.

releases.title: Balances that show they are updating

items.title: Loading shows when amounts are hidden
items.body: Wallet balances and revenue now show a short loading mark every 10 seconds as they refresh, even when your amounts are hidden.

items.title: Revenue and earnings too
items.body: Revenue, earnings, spending and the wallet figures now refresh together, so everything you see stays current.

releases.title: Fix for event creation in coordinator dashboard

items.title: Event creation fixed
items.body: Fixed an issue where tapping the Create event button in the event coordinator dashboard would not submit when optional location details were omitted.

items.title: See what is archived
items.body: If one of your albums was archived, you now see a clear notice on it. You keep your photos, and the notice tells you how to restore it on the Connekyt website so clients and buyers can open it again.
